title: [CRY2-6] Threshold multi-signer objects don't fit §13.1.1, and nothing requires distinct signer DID
description: Review finding CRY2-6: Threshold multi-signer objects don't fit §13.1.1, and nothing requires distinct signer DIDs (lens CRY2). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:18; spec/13-encoding.md:59, 78, 86. Fix: Confirmed. §13.1.1 knows only "an entry for every required signer" and rejects "an entry from a signer that is not required". For "at least `threshold` of `guardian.dids`", the required set is undefined. Nothing stops two entries whose `kid`s are different authentication keys of one guardian DID. Fix: add a threshold rule to §13.1.1. The defining section names a candidate DID set and k. The verifier requires entries from at least k distinct DIDs in the set, rejects an object with two entries from the same DID, and rejects entries from DIDs outside the set. Point 04:18 at that rule. Full text: notes/review2/CRY2-verified.md and notes/review2/CRY2.md.
